notes: Champion select tunables (champ-select). performance: hoverDebounceSeconds = how long a hover must settle before the 3D body starts streaming (0.12-0.2 feels instant without loading every tile the mouse crosses); paragonHoverDebounceSeconds = the same for the much heavier Paragon bodies (0.9 while the Paragon meshes still rebuild for 5-7 s on their first load each editor session; about 0.35 once Tools/ResaveParagonMeshes.py has been run); preloadParagonNeighbours = also preload Paragon bodies next to the hovered hero (off: in the editor each Paragon mesh rebuilds for seconds on its first load); bodyCacheSize = streamed bodies kept resident; backgroundCacheSize = painted scenes kept resident (pinned full resolution); previewPoolSize = spawned preview bodies kept hidden for instant revisits (counts the visible one); neighbourPreload = bodies preloaded either side of the hovered hero once it is on screen; crossFadeSeconds = scene and card-to-body crossfade; asyncLoadingTimeLimitMs = game-thread async-loading budget per frame while champion select is open (UE default 5).
